question: Compare uniform versus adaptive collection on four fresh calibrated planning tasks at exactly 180 CLI calls per model and collector.
adaptive_rule: Unchanged SARA-inspired fixed-group adaptation: after two completed unanimous rewards, p_effective=(4-2)/5=.4 < .45, so abandon. A mixed prefix continues to four. No unseen outcomes or gold costs used in scheduling.
uniform_rule: Complete groups of four. Same task stream in all arms.
task_order: Two disjoint tasks per block. random.Random(274000+100*block+cycle).shuffle(group). Each arm traverses the same ordered stream, although adaptive stopping changes how many groups fit.
primary: Number of complete mixed groups of exactly four known-reward trajectories per 180 CLI invocations, by policy. Also report both 90-call blocks.
budget: Same 180-call budget as the earlier primary comparison. Calibration is separately recorded and excluded. Calls are matched; tokens, time and dollars are not.
failures: Transport error stops new calls and has unknown reward. No automatic retries or fill-in. Budget truncations remain unknown. Exact task failures have reward 0. Native successful writes alone do not prove task correctness.
reward: A complete feasible final state with globally minimum total penalty points receives 1. Total penalty is weighted movement in minutes plus every applicable fixed handoff charge. Any optimum is accepted. Invalid constraints or higher cost receive 0. Independently checked by exact search, SciPy/HiGHS MILP, small exhaustive controls and native tool witnesses.

research.name: SARA
research.use: Unchanged collection-only adaptation, isolating task difficulty.

research.name: CERO
research.use: Recent training-horizon budget pacing research. No training horizon or learning here; not replicated.

research.name: Adaptive decoding methods
research.use: Recent token-support schedules require decoding access and training; unavailable in the fixed CLI policy. Not replicated.

research.name: PAIR
research.use: Selection and pair-inclusion bias caution; deterministic abandonment is not an unbiased gradient estimator.

limits: Four generated tasks and two blocks are descriptive. Calibration deliberately targets a performance boundary. CLI weights, random seeds and log probabilities are not attested. No measured training benefit.
calibration: Separate eight-attempt calibration per level; target two to six successes and within-task contrast.
legacy_units: objective_minutes, optimum_minutes and objective_gap_minutes contain total penalty points for these handoff fixtures.
interface: Explicit UTC timezone fields are required by the displayed schema and explained in the initial observation. A controlled native-binding audit and pre-comparison amendment record this clarification.
